mapper.select: SELECT user_id, login_id, name, email, region_id, status FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND password_hash = #{passwordHash} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT user_id, login_id, name, email, password_hash, region_id, favorite_crop_id, status, deleted_at FROM users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} AND password_hash = #{passwordHash} LIMIT 1

SELECT user_id, login_id, name, email, status, deleted_at FROM users WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET status = 'ACTIVE', deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'DELETED' AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY)
